source.provider: Iowa Environmental Mesonet (IEM), Iowa State University — ASOS/METAR archive

time.basis: valid_utc is the METAR observation time in UTC (ISO 8601, Z). valid_local = UTC+4 (Asia/Dubai, no DST), naive wall time.

units.rh_pct: % — computed by IEM from the integer T/Td
units.wind_speed_ms: m/s (converted from knots × 0.514444), 10 m anemometer, 2-min mean (METAR convention)
units.qnh_hpa: hPa — QNH from METAR Q group (sea-level-reduced; NOT surface pressure)
units.wx: present-weather codes (e.g. HZ, DU, BR, FG)
